Production process_original_once succeeds, assert_terminal_ack passes, replayed disk registry row is Completed Approved(reason=checked); otherwise Alcotest.fail.

limits: The six subscenarios belong to one Alcotest case; they are not six additional cases.

Alcotest verbose output prints ASSERT labels rather than numeric operands. Expected values and branch meaning are bound to exact compiled source; enclosing case OK establishes these assertions passed.

apply0/observe0 counters directly measure the scoped guarded commit. Production process_original_once separately has exact refusal and state-preservation assertions; its callback counts are not independently instrumented.
Reviewer is the scoped fixture reviewer, not an external provider; actual host/Workspace/Owner/registry file effects run in temporary fixture workspaces.
Positive Task Done and replayed Approved/Owner ACK pattern matches do not print dedicated success lines; exact source and enclosing case OK are their evidence.
